facts.fact: Duchess 派来的华丽马车把她从塔里一路送到城堡，速度破纪录。
facts.anchor: The flamboyant stagecoach the Duchess had sent for me made the trip from my tower to the castle in record time.

facts.fact: 曾经生机勃勃的花园被修剪成整齐划一的暗色树篱行列，像一张巨型棋盘。
facts.anchor: had been reduced to gloomy rows and columns of uniformly cut hedges that, if I squinted ever so slightly, looked almost like a giant chessboard

facts.fact: 城堡整体融进夜色，一切与从前反了过来。
facts.anchor: Everything was a stark contrast to what the castle used to be—reversed, backward.

facts.fact: 跨过城堡门槛时，有一股集中的力量震过她的身体。
facts.anchor: A snap of warmth, of concentrated power, shuddered through me as I crossed the threshold into the castle.

facts.fact: 邀请函在她指间化为暖尘与银火花，消失在空中。
facts.anchor: The invitation parchment trembled between my fingers before dissolving into a whisper of warm dust and silver sparks, vanishing into the air.

facts.fact: 有人从人群里掷刀行刺国王：站位无遮蔽，且国王的卫兵恰好全被引开。
facts.anchor: A blade thrown from that distance would reach him before his magic could react. And somehow, the king’s armed guards were all conveniently distracted.

facts.fact: 她把一只靴子甩向国王、擦中他的王冠，把他惊得低头躲开了原本致命的一刀。
章末收束：那个本该今夜死去的国王活了下来——因为她曾爱过他。
facts.anchor: a king who should have died tonight stood very much alive—because I had loved him once
